prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Paint the attached paint_mask_guide.png exactly according to this brief. Input roles: design_reference.png is material/detail reference; icon_x8.png is color reference (magenta background ignored); paint_mask_guide.png is the EDIT TARGET, immutable layout and silhouettes.
# Gungnir: paint + material mask view atlas

Scope: image generation only. Write ONLY into `level_generation/props/items_mm9_claude/codex_tex/d10189/`. Do not edit any other file, do not run builds.

Inputs (attached):
- `paint_mask_guide.png`: 1536x2048 transparent sheet, three columns by FOUR rows of 512x512 cells. Rows 1-2 and rows
  3-4 hold the same five grey orthographic renders of the exact 3D model: FRONT, BACK, LEFT / RIGHT, TOP, empty.

Task: use your built-in image generation tool to paint the guide sheet. Output ONE PNG with a transparent background
and a 3:4 canvas (1536x2048 or the tool's nearest 3:4 size), the same layout, each object in exactly the same position,
size and outline as its grey guide. Paint the grey objects only; never redraw, enlarge, move or redesign them.

- Rows 1-2 (PAINT): the unlit base colour of the item on each view: Faithfully extrapolate the complete MM9 Gungnir in MM6-MM8 inventory style. Preserve the gold central leaf point with two backward barbs, vivid red shaft, sparse gold bands, and ornate gold butt. Render one complete full-length spear on genuine transparent RGBA without redesign or generic substitution..
- Rows 3-4 (MATERIAL MASK): the same five silhouettes filled with FLAT pure colours only, no shading, no texture, no
  outlines, no antialiased colour blends inside:
  - pure red #FF0000: every metal part (steel, iron, chain mail, gold, silver, bronze, copper, brass)
  - pure green #00FF00: every leather part (straps, padding, hide, suede) and fur
  - pure blue #0000FF: every cloth part (tabards, quilting, linings, cords, ribbons) and hair
  - pure yellow #FFFF00: every matte non-metal solid (wood, bone, horn, stone, parchment, paper, wax)
  - pure black #000000: every gemstone, crystal, glass, pearl, enamel or liquid seen through glass
  Every pixel of each silhouette gets exactly one of these colours; nothing outside the silhouettes.
- `design_reference.png`: the approved HD painting or master of the item, the material and detail reference.
- `icon_x8.png`: the original game icon (magenta is background), the colour reference.

Object: Faithfully extrapolate the complete MM9 Gungnir in MM6-MM8 inventory style. Preserve the gold central leaf point with two backward barbs, vivid red shaft, sparse gold bands, and ornate gold butt. Render one complete full-length spear on genuine transparent RGBA without redesign or generic substitution.

- Facets, engravings, scrollwork and inner swirls follow the design reference, scaled to each view.
- Keep every gap and opening exactly as in the guide and fully transparent.
- Unlit base colour only: no lighting, no cast shadows, no ambient occlusion, no hot highlights or reflections, no
  glow halo, sparkles or aura outside the silhouette, no ground, no outlines, no text.
- The empty cells (column 3 of row 2 and row 4) stay empty and transparent.

Save the generated image (copy the file the tool produced) to `level_generation/props/items_mm9_claude/codex_tex/d10189/paint_mask_raw_v1.png` and write
`generation_paint.json` (prompt, inputs with sha256, original output path, output, size). At most one corrective
regeneration, only if the silhouettes or layout are clearly wrong.

CORRECTION: Output must be 1536x2048 (3:4), NOT a tall narrow canvas. Precisely retain the guide's four equally sized rows and three columns across the ENTIRE canvas. Do not leave additional empty rows at bottom. Preserve original clean silhouettes exactly with absolutely no stray pixels, roughness, aura or flecks outside. All five views in lower half must be solid flat material classification colors; lacquered wooden red shaft is YELLOW in mask, gold components RED. Top half shaft vivid red, metal gold, flat unlit albedo. Guide is authoritative for shape, not reference painting. Copy guide alpha geometry.
validation: Layout corrected; visible stray pixels and silhouette deviations remain. Raw output preserved.
